observations: body L1-L3: the end of the addendum to p. lxxv and 272, begun on p. XVII. «lāfūn» and «ūḥ» are italic, «mir’āh» is roman.
body L4, L34: paragraphs beginning inside the entries, set from the paragraph indent of the hanging lines.

body L2-L35: «Kushāǵim» (L2), «Suter», «Valafridi Stra-» «bonis», «P. Marty», «Sahl ibn Bishr», «Abū Ma‘shar», «Pusey», «Abū Naṣr al-Qummī», «Ahl-» «wardt», «At-Tahānawī», «Na-» «ṣīr ad-dīn aṭ-Ṭūsī», «Nicoll», «Oloug» «Beg» and «Pseudo-Pro-» «clus» are letter-spaced; «Abū ’l-‘Alā’» (L3) is not.
body L7-L10: Suter's German words are quoted with a guillemet at the head of each line; the volume number «19» of the Mitteilungen is bold.
body L11, L14: the pages of the first volume at the margin, «lxxvii» and «lxxviii» in small capitals, the second with the arabic page «297».
body L11: the opening words of the London copy, set right to left between the Latin parentheses as printed.

body L16-L17: the words of Abū Ma‘shar's preface are set right to left inside the Latin lines as printed: on L16 «praef.:» stands at the left margin and the Arabic runs from «فهذه» at the right margin to «بالاتصالات» beside «praef.:»; on L17 «بعضها ببعض» stands at the left margin, its first word beside the guillemet.
body L19-L20: the title of the table, «يشتمل على شرح اتصالات الكواكب العلوية», runs from the right margin of L19 to «278,a)», and «وممازجاتها الكواكب السفلية» stands at the head of L20.
body L22: the title of tract V, chapter I of the Bāri‘ stands between «inscribitur:» and the guillemet.
body L25: «نظر» stands inside the parenthesis «(s. v.» «):», and the definition «ونظرات القمر تسمى امتزاجات وممازجات القمر» between the colon and the guillemet.
body L27-L28: the title of chapter XIII begins with «في» at the right margin of L27 and continues at the head of L28.
body L30: the Persian words of Ulugh Beg, «از براى اتصال قمر با كوكب», are transcribed with the letters as printed; the final yā’ of «براى» has no dots.
body L31-L32: «جدول» ends L31; «مزاجات قمر بالكواكب» begins L32.

body L11, L16, L19, L22, L28: the lām-alif of «الاثني» (L11, L16) and «الاحكام» (L22) is printed with its two strokes crossing, like an X; in «بالاتصالات» (L16), «اتصالات» (L19) and «وانتقالاته» (L28) it has the ordinary form.
body L27: «dīn» has a short flat macron over the i (1.9 by 1.0 pt; the dots of the i on this line measure 1.2-1.4 pt).

body L34-L37: the κ of the Greek is printed in the open form of this type (ϰ), the θ of «ποιεῖσθαι» in its curled form (ϑ); they are transcribed κ and θ. The ω of «ζῴδια» prints broken, with the iota subscript below it; the ι of «ζῴδια» and of the second «καὶ» (L36) print broken, like an exclamation mark.
body: the dashes measure 9.2-10.4 pt (L1, L21, L24, L26, L29, L32); the hyphens 3.1-4.3 pt.
body L2, L5, L29, L30: the o of «quo», the d of «medii» and of «Bodleianae» and the t of «tabulam» print broken.
body L6, L8: a tick over the m of «circumfertur», a tick before «dem» and a dot under the m of «einem» are specks.

notes_left L1-L9, notes_right L1-L9: three notes in two columns, with a thin rule between them; note 2 runs from the left column into the right. «Kushāǵim» (notes_left L2), «Brockelmann», «Huart», «Ibn Khalli-» «kān», «Albumasar», «Suter», «Steinschneider», «Loth» and «Pusey» are letter-spaced; «Kushāǵim» on notes_left L4 and L6 is not. The dash of notes_left L3 measures 7.9 pt.
notes_left L5: «Wüst» is printed without a stop, the comma standing 2.9 pt after the t; the closing parenthesis after «as-Sarī» prints thin and broken.
notes_left L7: the hyphen of «216-220» is printed short (1.7 pt).
notes_right L2: the ǵ of «ǵumal» is the italic g with the acute joined to its top, like the ǵ of the body (L14, L26, L27, L33).
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
